module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  load,
    input  ena,
    input  [3:0] data,
    output reg [3:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk or posedge areset) begin
        if (areset) begin
            q <= 4'b0;
        end else if (load) begin
            q <= data;
        end else if (ena) begin
            q <= {1'b0, q[3:1]};
        end
    end

endmodule
